summary:
Mobile-first Unity 2D game Mars space training game focused on kid learning with choice and consequences. We implemented the game focused on children knowing that the majority of the kids play or have played on mobile devices mainly. 

The team developed the main assets of the game and work on the logic and minigames. Original designs and pictures were used for the interface and minigame design. Using NASA's research papers, we explained the logic behind some of NASA's basics for children comprehension. 

The minigames consist on some main attributes that astronauts need to manage: 

* Electricity
* Life Support
* Science (Learning)
details:
It is a mobile game with option to run on a personal computer developed in unity, mainly focused on education of junior kids on decision making in an astronaut outpost in Mars.

What we looked for in the project is the accessibility of the kids and look for engagement to kids. We implement decision makings scenarios that explain the outcome based on player's choice. We used the game engine Unity, custom self-made sprites, custom self-made music and some ai generated backgrounds. The idea of the project is made to give a fun experience to kids and help give them an understanding of space.

For the development of scripts in Unity, we used C# and assistance of AI for the behavior in the interaction in the minigames.

Our project is creative because we were focused on a project towards kids and the platform of mobile as the main way of distribution.

We considered factors like ease of use, simple but learning focused minigames.
